capabilities: Watch folders for newly created markdown files
Apply per-folder metadata rules to new notes
Convert comma-separated values into list properties
disambiguation: Not a templating plugin; it applies fixed key/value metadata rules per folder rather than generating note content.
extras: The README mixes English and Chinese UI labels (新增规则). Rules only affect newly created files; existing files are never rewritten.
problem: Notes created by other plugins or dropped into folders lack consistent frontmatter, so metadata queries like Dataview or Bases can't find or classify them.
summary: Rule-based automation that writes preset frontmatter properties into newly created notes based on the folder they appear in.
